Clean all solenoid valves, the cleaning 
 interval will depending on the media and service conditions in general, if the 
 voltage to the coil is correct, sluggish valve operation or excessive leakage 
 will indicate that cleaning is required.

Apply a proper air pressure to the inlet of the solenoid valve. 
 ref. value 500 PSI

Check 
 the leakage from the out let (must be none).

Apply 
 125 VDC to the coil terminals.
Be sure the solenoid valve opened and the air comes out from the outlet.
If the valve is working good ok otherwise change the valve.

Ensure that the CO2 gate is closed at the turbine 
 compartment.

Check up the close setting by using gun at the setting if it is correct 
 ok, otherwise change the detector.

Work to be Carried Out
Solenoid Valve
Review technical reference material manufactures setting / manual.
Clean all solenoid valves, the cleaning 
 interval will depending on the media and service conditions in general, if the 
 voltage to the coil is correct, sluggish valve operation or excessive leakage 
 will indicate that cleaning is required.
Apply a proper air pressure to the inlet of the solenoid valve. 
 ref. value 500 PSI
Check 
 the leakage from the out let (must be none).
Apply 
 125 VDC to the coil terminals.
Be sure the solenoid valve opened and the air comes out from the outlet.
If the valve is working good ok otherwise change the valve.
Ensure that the CO2 gate is closed at the turbine 
 compartment.
